authorization: User requested implementation of P09-P14 and chose public benchmark plus Vietnamese annotation kit; research implementation choices are authorized.
scope: Exploratory English public-data benchmark; not Vietnamese NLP, urgency, dispatch, mobile or field validation
task: Binary informativeness, only official pairs whose text and image informativeness labels agree
license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 as declared by QCRI; local noncommercial research; raw content and model artifacts not published

split.train: All other events from the union of the three official agreed-label splits
split.selection: Sort independent metadata groups by SHA256(seed + pair_id), no label balancing; choose one pair per tweet/normalized-text connected group; exclude groups spanning events
split.leakage_audit: Union by tweet_id, normalized cleaned text, exact image SHA256 and dHash Hamming <=4; drop all selected components spanning splits before training; preserve same remaining IDs across configurations

text.preprocessing: Unicode NFKC; remove URLs, @mentions and leading RT; collapse whitespace; no generated/translated text; preserve source encoding artifacts
text.features: TF-IDF word unigrams+bigrams, max_features=20000, min_df=2, sublinear_tf=true, L2; fit training only

image.encoder: torchvision MobileNetV3 Small IMAGENET1K_V1, frozen features+avgpool, 576 dimensions
image.preprocessing: EXIF transpose, RGB, official weights.transforms(): resize short edge256 bilinear, center crop224, ImageNet normalization

classifier.selection: highest validation macro-F1; ties choose lower C; all text/image/concat share grid; threshold .5 fixed
classifier.fusion: concatenate L2 text/image blocks divided by sqrt(2); train a linear classifier on common labels; additive learned feature fusion, no interaction layer or joint encoder training

missing_modality: Diagnostic only: zero one normalized feature block of fixed concat model; no retraining, no missing-modality robustness claim

analysis.bootstrap: paired percentile 95% CIs over image/text/tweet duplicate groups in test, 2000 draws, same draws all contrasts; single held-out event, conditional intervals only
analysis.multiple_comparisons: exploratory unadjusted CIs; report all contrasts; no familywise significance or superiority declaration
analysis.replication: one deterministic split and convex-classifier seed, no multi-event replication or deep-training seed variance claim

failures: Download/decode failures recorded, never silently replaced; any remaining failures block model comparison pending disposition; dataset selection committed before training
budget: CPU-only, <=3000 train +600 dev +all agreed Sri Lanka pairs; <=60min per pipeline command; no full encoder training
completion: source/selection/image hashes, leakage audit, cached embeddings, fitted artifacts, validation selection, test predictions, effect CIs and bounded interpretation; original rescue claims remain separate
